lead_raw_text:
The CeAl4Si structure crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4_1/amd (No. 143), with a unit cell containing 12 atoms (Ce2Al8Si2) across three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Al centers with 12 geometric neighbors (6 Al, 3 Ce, 3 Si) and Ce and Si centers with 16 neighbors each (12 Al plus 4 of the other element). The periodic neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner, edge, and face sharing among Al-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner/edge sharing between Al- and Ce- or Al- and Si-centered 16-vertex polyhedra.
